name: gh-comment
question: One issue comment that a recorded decision asks for, on an issue other than #218 (the maintainer's decision of 2026-11-26, #218 comment 7202383280, item 1: finding 8 on #224, the minor findings on #59). The extra arguments: issue comment <224|59> --repo klucilla/refute --body-file <committed file>. Permitted GitHub traffic only.
choices: A new unit file (rule (c)); units/gh.json is unchanged. In a job without the container; the operation and the endpoint are journaled. Only the subcommand issue comment on klucilla/refute issues 224 and 59, with a committed body file. A data unit: the arguments make the unit.
